explanation: Constructed and kernel-checked as one valid solid, with a 150 × 150 × 25 mm envelope and the requested XY/Z orientation. Includes the Ø95 bore, four internal keys with R2.5 reliefs, eight peripheral pockets with floors at Z=13, hole patterns, counterbores, diagonal workholding flats, chamfers and pocket-floor fillets. Chamfers around the bore were constructed analytically after direct edge chamfering failed. Ambiguities: the drawing does not explicitly dimension the bolt-circle diameters; Ø134 and Ø104 are inferred. Exterior pocket corners use inferred R5 centers at (±23,−62.5), repeated by symmetry, preserving the 46 mm spacing and 40°/100° wall angles. The 19.8/13.7 callouts have unclear reference edges among the fillets and chamfers and are not independently enforced as exact wall lengths. The 0.25 mm pocket chamfer is interpreted as applying to the exposed floor/OD edge, and the 0.5 mm chamfer to the upper pocket wall. These assumptions mean the reconstruction is not uniquely determined by the supplied dimensions.
